title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. rubra
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. rubra, commonly known as Red Chamomile or Red Clover, is a flowering plant in the legume family. This plant has been used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and prevent blood clots. The therapeutic actions of Red Chamomile include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Red Chamomile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and isoflavones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
